chunks: Hishām ibn Sālim narrated from Sulaymān ibn Khālid, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “Is there stoning in the Qur'an?” He said: “Yes.”
“The old man and the old woman—stone them absolutely, for they have fulfilled their desire.”

key_terms.الشَّيْخُ وَالشَّيْخَةُ: the elderly man and elderly woman, the categories named in the report
key_terms.الْقُرْآنِ: the Qur'an, mentioned here as the subject of inquiry

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the mention of stoning in the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This hadith records a question to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام about the mention of rajm in the Qur'an, to which he replies in the affirmative and cites a specific wording. The report is relevant to discussions of penal law and also to debates about the relationship between Qur'anic wording, legal rulings, and transmitted hadith in Shia sources.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4998 - Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Sulayman ibn Khalid who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about the stoning mentioned in the Quran.
Imam (as) replied: "Yes."
Imam (as) said: "The old man and the old woman - stone them absolutely, for they have fulfilled their desire."
